first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, and prior work shows shortening onboarding (memory_86) and signup simplification (memory_31) both improved activation durably. These are proven levers. Verifying both ensures we understand the specific mechanisms and any context changes since consolidation. Activation messaging (memory_91) provides secondary support—combined effect could address both the 6% activation dip and the 4% completion drop simultaneously. This approach avoids the revenue-risk of promotional pricing (which might train price-sensitive cohorts to wait for discounts) and the time constraint of enterprise sales assistance. One focused experiment on simplified onboarding maximizes probability of sustainable lift without cannibalizing margins or introducing dependency on continuous discounting.
